options.text: On day 6, the students completed an activity and reported what they learned in the 3-Ⅳ-12／熟悉閱讀技巧 task.
On day 6, the students stayed home and recorded nothing for the 3-Ⅳ-12／熟悉閱讀技巧 task.
On day 6, the students cancelled lunch before visiting the science room.
On day 6, the students bought a new bus for the 3-Ⅳ-12／熟悉閱讀技巧 task.

answer.explanation: The main idea includes the students' activity, record, and sharing of results. This item targets 3-Ⅳ-12／熟悉閱讀技巧, question 6.
